modules.title: Setup and Python Ecosystem
gaps: Keep setup instructions synchronized with the supported Python, uv, JupyterLab, and publication workflow.
modules.next_text_target: Maintenance text only when the runtime or author workflow changes.

modules.title: Markets, Instruments, and Data
gaps: Keep provider, rights, revision, actual sample, and constructed-series disclosures synchronized with every snapshot refresh.
modules.next_text_target: A concise cross-provider schema and market-infrastructure extension with auditable rights metadata.

modules.title: Quantitative Methods and Financial Time Series
gaps: Future Bayesian, clustering, and broader machine-learning cases must preserve time order, a benchmark, and interpretable limitations.
modules.next_text_target: A time-aware Bayesian or clustering extension that does not duplicate the portfolio module.

modules.title: Economics, Macro, and Currency
gaps: A future nowcasting or currency-overlay dashboard must preserve release dates, real-time vintages, quote conventions, and offline reproducibility; a latest-vintage panel with a one-month lag is not sufficient for point-in-time evaluation.

The current Ridge case is intentionally rejected because it fails naive FX benchmarks and its scenario sensitivities change sign across estimation windows; future predictive work must earn acceptance on untouched chronological data.
modules.next_text_target: A vintage-aware nowcasting or currency-overlay dashboard with an explicit benchmark.

modules.title: Financial Statement Analysis and Financial Modeling
gaps: A filing-backed executable case still requires a redistributable source, full statement reconciliation, and a durable audit trail.
modules.next_text_target: A licensed filing-backed three-statement case that reconciles every statement and adjustment.

modules.title: Corporate Issuers and Equity Valuation
gaps: A full equity-research case should add filing-backed forecasts and reconciliation without weakening the existing valuation controls.
modules.next_text_target: A filing-backed equity research case spanning forecasts, valuation, thesis, risks, and monitoring.

modules.title: Fixed Income, Credit, and Term Structure
gaps: Dealer-grade settlement calendars, credit curves, CDS, OAS, and loan-level securitization remain advanced extensions.
modules.next_text_target: A reviewed credit-curve or securitized-product case with contractual cash-flow validation.

modules.title: Derivatives and Risk Management
gaps: Counterparty credit, xVA, collateral, margin, and arbitrage-checked volatility surfaces remain advanced extensions.
modules.next_text_target: An arbitrage-checked volatility-surface or counterparty-risk case with explicit numerical governance.

modules.title: Alternative Investments
gaps: Manager-level empirical cases require auditable cash flows, privacy-safe inputs, and comparable after-fee benchmarks.
modules.next_text_target: A privacy-safe manager due-diligence case with liquidity and after-fee cash-flow analysis.

modules.title: Portfolio Management, Asset Allocation, and Performance
gaps: Full multi-period attribution, tax-lot optimization, and implementation-shortfall reporting remain advanced extensions.
modules.next_text_target: A reconciled performance-attribution case with fees, flows, turnover, and implementation shortfall.

modules.title: Advanced Pathways and Capstone
gaps: Additional datasets and committee cases must retain the same evidence contract, rubric, and privacy boundary.
modules.next_text_target: A second capstone dataset or committee case using the existing evidence and evaluation contract.
